thread:
jyoti: quick follow-up from the architecture sync 10. we keep seeing small but user-visible regressions when models are auto-quantized downstream. i'm proposing a focused 'quant-safety' gate in onboarding to catch these earlier.

marc: +1. we need a lightweight, deterministic set of checks that target quantization failure modes (token-id remap, clipped logits, sampling tail changes). ideally <3min extra.

bench-bot: i can run a "quant-safety" job. plan: convert model to ONNX/TVM int8, run N=48 compact prompts (short, emote-heavy, special tokens), compare against fp32 canonical run. serializer rules: NFKC unicode norm, strip zwsp, round floats to 3 decimals, output token-id seq + decoded text.

alice: what should be hard-fail vs advisory? we should block if token-id mapping changes or if deterministic prefix is lost. sampling distribution drift should be advisory unless it crosses a big threshold.

ryan: agree. suggested policy: HARD FAIL if token alignment mismatch >2 tokens OR special-token id differs. SOFT WARN if avg KL across seeds >0.3 or token-bleu < 0.85 for sampled outputs. SOFT => set model flag "no-auto-quant" and surface remediation.

jyoti: for SOFT we should also auto-create a remediation ticket with suggested exporter params (per-channel vs symmetric scales, clip thresholds) and include top-3 mismatched prompts + diffs. console-bot: can console surface that?

console-bot: yes 10. we can show a restricted badge "quant-safety: advisory" with actions: rerun conversion with alternate params, open remediation ticket, or request manual override. include a one-line token-diff and link to full artifact.

bench-bot: implementation notes: reuse golden store but add a quant-focused golden subset with emphasis on punctuation/special tokens and short fragments to reduce runtime. convert+run steps can be cached for repeated reruns. estimate ~90-150s per model if containers are warmed.

alice: add a probabilistic post-onboard canary: if SOFT->team requests quant, enable 0.5% traffic to quant path for 24h with verbose token-diff logging and automatic fallback on error or perplexity spike. that will catch issues that our small sample missed.

marc: long-term we should standardize token-id signing in exporters so we can't silently remap special tokens. short-term gate + remediation seems pragmatic. also add telemetry counters: token-shift histograms, quant-failure-rate per exporter, and ticket-to-fix latency.

jyoti: good. i'll update the onboarding RFC addendum: define stage "quant-safety", serializer spec, thresholds, restricted-flag semantics, remediation ticket template, and canary/runbook. will ping for review.

ryan: small ask: can bench-bot log the converter stdout/stderr on failures to make triage faster?

bench-bot: yes, will capture and attach sanitized logs. will redact paths and secrets.

console-bot: UX note: we should display the badge prominently on model summary and show suggested fixes in the action menu. i'll prototype copy and space.

alice: who owns thresholds? team decision or infra/ML?

jyoti: infra/ML sets defaults; model teams can request overrides with documented justification in the manual-override flow. defaults get reviewed quarterly.

marc: timeline: bench-bot job prototyping this week, pipeline change next sprint, console UX followup. i'll help with exporter edge-case tests.

jyoti: tagging followups: @bench-bot for job impl, @console-bot for badge UI, @marc for exporter tests. will post a short RFC patch in #eng-ml by EOD. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
